xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5617: npm run typecheck re-queues for admission on each of its 12 tsc lanes, so one typecheck takes about an hour under memory pressure

plan.title: npm run typecheck re-queues for admission on each of its 12 tsc lanes, so one typecheck takes about an hour under memory pressure
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: npm run typecheck chains 12 steps (13 tsc processes); each goes through scripts/tsc-admitted.mjs and takes its own gate admission, releasing its slot after the lane and re-queueing at the back for the next one. Under memory pressure each head can wait up to 5 minutes (PAN-5285) and other agents' typechecks interleave, so one typecheck took ~49 minutes for 6 of 12 lanes on 2026-11-23. npm run lint has the same shape in lint:effect-diagnostics (4 tsc lanes in a bash loop).
narratives.Proposal: Add scripts/gate-admitted.mjs <footprint-key> -- <command> [args...], a built-ins-only bypass plus a call to the existing generic runAdmittedCommand, so one admission covers a whole chain and its children run with OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED=1 (lanes then run tsc directly). Rename today's typecheck chain to typecheck:lanes and make typecheck = gate-admitted.mjs chain:typecheck -- npm run typecheck:lanes; wrap lint:effect-diagnostics the same way under chain:lint:effect-diagnostics. A chain fails closed (exit 75) on any admission timeout (memory, queue, slots or cpu) via a runner failClosedOnTimeout option; only a non-timeout setup failure runs it unadmitted, with OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION=0 so lanes do not each fail again. Lone lanes keep PAN-5248 D15. The Flywheel board labels chain:<script> gates as <script>. Footprint is the chain's own recorded tree peak (= largest lane, lanes run in series). Docs (PIPELINE-GATES.md, CLAUDE.md, codebase stack.md, tsc-admitted.mjs header) and changelog.d/pan-5617.md describe the new behavior.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the admission algorithm in src/lib/cloister/quality-gate-admission.ts (queue order, memory rule, 25-minute stale bound, slots)
- No lease heartbeat or renewal for long-held slots
- No change to any typecheck:<lane> script; npm run typecheck:share run alone still admits twice
- No change to the verification gate (src/lib/cloister/validation.ts) or its gate:typecheck:npm run typecheck key
- bash scripts/lint-effect-diagnostics.sh run directly (including --update) still admits per lane
- No seeding of a chain's first-run footprint from its lanes' estimates
- No change to the lint script string in package.json or to scripts/run-lint-group.mjs
- No change to scripts/tsc-admitted.mjs behavior or imports (header comment only)
- No new configuration key
- No test drives the real admission queue or uses real timers
- Extra arguments after `npm run typecheck --` are not forwarded to the last lane any more (they reach the inner `npm run typecheck:lanes`); no caller passes them

autoDecisions.summary: One generic wrapper scripts/gate-admitted.mjs instead of a mode in tsc-admitted.mjs
autoDecisions.rationale: tests/unit/scripts/lint-effect-diagnostics.test.ts copies tsc-admitted.mjs standalone, and runAdmittedCommand is already generic over command/args/key, so a thin new script reuses it without touching the lane wrapper.

autoDecisions.summary: Move today's typecheck chain to typecheck:lanes; typecheck wraps it
autoDecisions.rationale: Lane scripts stay byte-identical so a lane run alone keeps self-admitting (FR-1), and the verification gate's npm run typecheck still bypasses because it already carries OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED=1.

autoDecisions.summary: Wrap lint:effect-diagnostics in package.json, not by re-exec inside the .sh
autoDecisions.rationale: run-lint-group.mjs maps the exact lint step string, and the .sh test copies only the .sh and tsc-admitted.mjs into a temp root; a package.json body change touches neither.

autoDecisions.summary: Chain footprint = the chain's own recorded tree peak under chain:<script>; first run uses the 2.5 GiB default
autoDecisions.rationale: Lanes run in series so the tree peak equals the largest lane (host data: gate:typecheck peaks 2.6 GiB vs largest lane 2.45 GiB); peers read estimates by key, so a computed max-of-lanes would be invisible to them. The effect-diag chain under-reserves ~0.5 GiB once, which the soft reserve absorbs.

autoDecisions.summary: A chain exits 75 on any admission timeout; only a non-timeout setup failure runs it unadmitted with OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION=0
autoDecisions.rationale: Critique round 1: the timeout carries the last wait kind, which is queue or slots for any waiter behind other gates even when memory is the real cause, so memory-only fail-closed would let a timed-out chain start all 13 tsc processes unadmitted. A setup failure cannot be fixed by waiting, and the propagated opt-out stops each lane failing the same way. Lone lanes keep PAN-5248 D15.
The stale bound is 25 minutes and recent verification-gate typechecks (which already hold one slot for the whole chain) ran 110-270 s, outlier 912 s.
gateLabel in src/lib/flywheel/board.ts otherwise prints the raw key; matching the existing tsc:/gate: label rules is the smallest consistent change.

autoDecisions.summary: A chain waits up to 60 minutes for admission (CHAIN_MAX_WAIT_MS), a lane 30
autoDecisions.rationale: acquireQualityGateAdmission times out on now() - createdAt > maxWaitMs from ticket creation at any queue position. A chain waits once behind whole-chain holders; under the issue's conditions (6 typechecks, heads waiting 5 min for memory then running alone) the last chain would pass 30 minutes and a memory-reason timeout would exit 75, failing a typecheck that used to succeed slowly. 60 minutes still fails closed eventually as PAN-5248 requires.

metadata.sizeJustification: Small change: 1 new script, 1 runner tweak, 2 package.json script bodies, 1 label rule, docs.

items.title: Runner: chain timeouts fail closed, setup failures give children OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION=0, CHAIN_MAX_WAIT_MS, one-admission-per-chain tests

expected_outputs: gate-admission-run.test.ts passes including the new 'admitted chains (PAN-5617)' tests
metadata.acJustification: Seven ACs: the runner carries three distinct failure paths (memory timeout, other timeout for chains, setup failure) plus the lone-lane regression guard, the chain-once proof and the wait-bound constant; splitting would put one 20-line catch block across items.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. Add RunAdmittedDeps.failClosedOnTimeout, export CHAIN_MAX_WAIT_MS = 60 * 60_000, admissionTimeoutKindOf and timeoutRefusalMessage. In runAdmittedCommand's catch: memory timeout returns 75 as today; else if failClosedOnTimeout and the error is a QualityGateAdmissionTimeoutError, warn timeoutRefusalMessage and return 75 without spawning; else warn 'proceeding without admission' and set proceedingUnadmitted. childEnv = handle ? {...env, OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED:'1'} : proceedingUnadmitted ? {...env, OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION:'0'} : env. Update the module header comment. Add PRD WI-1 tests 1-7 using injected acquire/spawn/env only (no real queue, no timers).

items.title: Given an outer runAdmittedCommand for chain:typecheck whose fake child runs 12 inner runAdmittedCommand lanes with the env it received, when it completes, then the shared acquire spy was called exactly once with footprintKey chain:typecheck and each of the 12 inner spawns received OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED=1

Given failClosedOnTimeout true and an acquire that throws new Error('EACCES: admission root'), when runAdmittedCommand runs, then it spawns the child with OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION=0 and without OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED, and inner lanes started with that env make no further acquire call

Given env {} and a single tsc:tsconfig.json lane, when runAdmittedCommand runs, then acquire is called exactly once and the existing test expecting env { PATH: '/bin', OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED: '1' } still passes unchanged
Given a memory-reason admission timeout, when runAdmittedCommand runs, then it still returns 75 and never spawns (existing test passes)

gate-admission-run.ts exports CHAIN_MAX_WAIT_MS = 3600000, and given maxWaitMs CHAIN_MAX_WAIT_MS with an acquire that throws a memory-reason timeout, runAdmittedCommand returns 75 and prints a line containing 'waited 60 minutes for memory'

Given failClosedOnTimeout true and an acquire that throws QualityGateAdmissionTimeoutError(CHAIN_MAX_WAIT_MS, kind) for kind queue, slots or cpu, when runAdmittedCommand runs, then it returns 75, never spawns, and prints '[gate-admission] refusing to start tsc:tsconfig.json: waited 60 minutes for admission (last waiting on <kind>)'
Given failClosedOnTimeout unset and an acquire that throws a queue timeout, when runAdmittedCommand runs for a lone lane, then it falls back to spawning once and returns 0

narrative.Action: Create scripts/gate-admitted.mjs with the exact structure in PRD WI-2: argv `<footprint-key> -- <command> [args...]`, usage line + exit 2 on malformed argv, bypass under CI / OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION=0 / OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED=1 that loads only node:child_process and node:os, otherwise load src/lib/cloister/gate-admission-run.ts through tsx and set process.exitCode from runAdmittedCommand({footprintKey, command, args, cwd: process.cwd()}); if the tsx load fails, warn and runDirect with OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION=0. Write tests/unit/scripts/gate-admitted.test.ts per PRD WI-2 using spawnSync(process.execPath, ...) with env {...process.env, OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED:'1'} so the real queue is never touched. The admitted branch calls run.runAdmittedCommand({ footprintKey, command, args, cwd: process.cwd() }, { maxWaitMs: run.CHAIN_MAX_WAIT_MS, failClosedOnTimeout: true }). Add PRD WI-2 test 4 (copy the script alone into a mkdtemp root, strip CI/OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED/OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION, assert the child prints OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION '0' and stderr has the 'proceeding without admission:' line).

items.title: Given OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED=1, when node scripts/gate-admitted.mjs chain:test -- <node> -e 'process.exit(3)' runs, then the wrapper exits 3
Given OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED=1, when the wrapped node command prints its args and OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED with extra args a b, then stdout equals 'a,b|1'

When the wrapper is called with argv missing the key, the `--` separator, or the command, then it exits 2 and writes 'usage: node scripts/gate-admitted.mjs <footprint-key> -- <command> [args…]' to stderr
The bypass branch of scripts/gate-admitted.mjs contains no dynamic import; only the non-bypass branch imports tsx/esm/api and gate-admission-run.ts

Given the script copied alone into a temp root and no bypass env, when it runs a node command that prints OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION, then the child prints '0', the wrapper exits 0, and stderr contains '[gate-admission] proceeding without admission:'

The admitted branch of scripts/gate-admitted.mjs passes { maxWaitMs: run.CHAIN_MAX_WAIT_MS, failClosedOnTimeout: true } to runAdmittedCommand, and its header comment states that any admission timeout exits 75
